checks.detail: Expected 8 pages; generated 8.
Each required heading must appear on its intended page.
The branded cover must identify the product, category, decision, and report version.
Executive recommendation includes the canonical decision facts, strength, watch point, audience meaning, and priorities.
A clean product GO must authorize launch preparation without being downgraded by concept evidence.
Low concept n limits named consumer and market claims without downgrading product GO.
Launch-blocking language is prohibited unless a separate critical product gate has failed.
Report follows cover, recommendation, performance, response, action, and evidence/release flow.
The executive page must explain evidence quality and translate the management authorization for each audience.
The action plan identifies controlled workstreams, methods, passing evidence, ownership, timing, and gates.
Product readiness is converted into explicit protect, improve, and validate controls.
Consumer/concept response translates the proposition, target, promise, price hypothesis, evidence boundary, and commercial meaning.
Blocked claim status must be defined inside the final external-claim release record.
The report must disclose study populations, respondent-profile coverage, privacy suppression, and the representativeness boundary.
Literature must be presented as a source register with explicit uses, non-uses, and study-design implications.
Every deterministic decision factor is shown against the readiness line with a business implication.
Project instrumental context, literature guidance, and the project study basis must remain visibly separate.
The commercial proposition must disclose the concept sample size and evidence boundary.
Consumer/concept page presents the proposition, priority consumer, product promise, price hypothesis, and observed response.
Final page closes with claim-level evidence, wording permissions, limitations, literature, and release status.
Material claims must map to stable evidence-register entries and state their release requirement.
Technical identifiers and calculation tables are excluded from the client PDF.
Forbidden generic interpretation phrases are absent.
Client-facing numbers must not contain raw floating-point artifacts.
Product identity must remain consistent with the selected product format.
Client-facing text must not contain internal evidence or system phrases.
Client-facing literature must not expose storage paths, raw filenames, or retrieval-pack identifiers.
Client-facing copy must not contain sentence fragments or known generated-language failures.
Product direction must translate evidence rather than dump raw metrics.
No repeated caveat sentence detected.
